title: Varicella-zoster Post-Exposure Prophylaxis (PEP) Information for GPs
summary: Report suspected cases of exposure to varicella-zoster virus to the Public Health Agency (PHA) duty room, telephone 0300 555 0119. Refer to UKHSA guidelines on post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) for varicella or shingles, and Green Book Chapter 34 (external content). The Regional Virus Laboratory website has referral forms (external content).
changeSummary: Initial transcription from Eolas Medical, Northern Ireland Primary Care Antimicrobial Guidelines (v5.119.0).
clinicalNotes: No drug regimen is given on the Eolas page; PEP decisions are made with the PHA duty room.
